**Expanded security notes: every alert sends aircraft/location data off-host through each configured notification target.**

- Updated the "Security & safety" section to clarify that all alerts transmit matched aircraft coordinates and alert data to external services (Telegram/webhook).
- Stressed that users should treat notification target configuration as an explicit part of their threat model.
- Reworded notification config docs and repeated the off-host data warning in the notifications section.

planesnitch 1.8.0

- Improved SKILL.md with a detailed overview of features, security, use cases, and configuration instructions.
- Clarified which ADS-B sources are supported (adsb.lol, adsb.fi, airplanes.live, adsb.one, or your own ultrafeeder).
- Documented new and existing alert types (military/gov/police via CSVs, squawk emergencies, ICAO/type lists, low-flyers, or all aircraft).
- Enhanced configuration examples and explanations for Docker, Telegram, webhooks, and watchlists.
- Strengthened security notes regarding outbound traffic, secrets in config.yaml, and notification targets.
- Expanded setup walkthrough, including example YAML and usage scenarios, for easier onboarding.
